tests.name: wild and trainer Pokemon evolve as far as their level allows (22 cases)
before any badge the floor is 0
with the first badge the floor is the first leader's level (19), not three below
with two badges it is the second leader's level (24)
a badge won out of order does not raise the floor
with all eight Johto badges the floor is the last Johto leader level (53)
a wild Pokemon below the floor is raised to the last leader's level and evolved to match (Totodile 12 -> Croconaw 19)
a wild Pokemon above the floor keeps its level and still evolves (Totodile 30 -> Feraligatr)
before any badge nothing changes
a wild Pokemon with no attack of its type gets one (every type checked, three times each)
a Pokemon that already has one keeps its moves
with only five badges nothing is added
with six badges it is added
the wild hook does nothing in a trainer battle
a dual-type Pokemon gets a move of either type
a trainer's Pokemon gets a move of its own type from the sixth badge on
a trainer's Pokemon keeps its moves before that
Tito remembers Fairy moves for a Fairy-type Pokemon (Mr. Mime, level 60)
only those its level allows at level 20
moves it already knows are not offered again
a Pokemon that is not Fairy type gets none
wild encounters on Route 32 with one badge are all at least level 19
and every one of them is evolved as far as its level allows
fishing and tree encounters get the same floor and evolution (Totodile 12 with one badge -> Croconaw 19)
with no badges Route 32 keeps its own levels
no trainer party (795 parties checked) keeps a Pokemon that its level should have evolved
with six badges every Pokemon in every trainer party has a damaging move of its own type
with six badges every one of the 251 wild species is generated with a damaging move of its own type
with five badges some are still generated without one
POISON_JAB is a poison physical move of power 80 with a chance to poison
CROSS_POISON is a poison physical move of power 70 with a chance to poison
GUNK_SHOT is a poison physical move of power 120 with a chance to poison
SLUDGE_WAVE is a poison special move of power 95 with a chance to poison
the four new Poison moves have their own names
TMs are never used up (no ConsumeTM)
